# MyWorkFlo

> MyWorkFlo is an AI front desk for HVAC and home-service teams. Calls still ring the business first — when one is missed, MyWorkFlo texts the customer back in seconds, books the visit if it's simple, and alerts a human if it sounds urgent.

## Key facts

- Built for small HVAC and home-service shops — from solo operators to multi-tech teams.
- Self-serve setup in about 10 minutes; no demo or sales call required. No contract, no setup fee — cancel anytime.
- Your phone number stays the same; calls ring the business first and MyWorkFlo steps in only when a call is missed.
- Real calendar booking is included on every plan, not an upsell.
- Emergency-keyword triage: gas smell, flooding, sparks, or a burning smell trigger a locked, pre-approved safety script and instant human handoff.
- Texts with customers in English and Spanish on every plan.
- Three control modes: Draft (staff approves every message), Assisted (texts on its own, bookings wait for approval), Autopilot (approved appointment types book automatically).
- It will not guess at repairs, invent arrival times, or quote prices it isn't sure about.
- Works alongside existing tools (business phone, texts, Google Calendar, email) — no website required.

## Pricing (per month)

- Starter — $119/mo: solo operators; missed-call text-back, real calendar booking, emergency detection, English/Spanish texting.
- Growth — $299/mo: 2–10 tech businesses; round-the-clock missed-call coverage, one-tap booking approval, office staff seats, lead dashboard.
- Pro — $599/mo: bigger multi-tech operations; everything in Growth plus multiple numbers/locations, custom setup with the MyWorkFlo team, priority support.
